title: ID0469351-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] Modbus setup for ELMS not successful
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Modbus setup for ELMS not successful.
Charger local IP for modbus:
192.168.1.101 for UBPBfx
192.168.1.102 for ijxuQB
both with port 502
Solution: Attach Ethernet cable to FA13 instead of FA6

additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good afternoon.
I checked the ELMS system and it's transmitting correctly
I'm just not sure why, we cannot ping your addresses 192.168.1.101/102, I believe that maybe the Wired connection is not correct or something might be wrong with FA13.
First thing I would like to have is understand where the connection is done, if it's to FA13, I would like to test if we wire the cable until the Router directly.
If it's connected to FA6 then it's wrong and we need to change the wire.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hi Bas, good morning and Happy New year!
If it's the left most port that they connected then it's incorrect, they need to insert in FA13 or directly in the WAN port of XF3.
That should be the first step here. After the connections are done, I will proceed to check again if I can ping the addresses.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0469351-DC/Si-D/NL-[Multiple] Modbus setup for ELMS not successful CRM:02681001271
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good morning!
So from our chat today morning, it seems that the customer is able to see the values on the ELMS.
From my side, then, it's clear that the only thing that didn't work here was the fact that they inserted the cable in XF4 instead of XF3.
I will proceed to close the ticket. If you have any further questions, please feel free to write in chat.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
